summary: Computer Science senior graduating December 2026 and Industrial IoT/Data Engineering intern with more than one year of experience building production data workflows, operational analytics, fault-tested distributed systems, and ML infrastructure. C++17, Python, and SQL work spans Raft/MVCC, vectorized query execution, paged-KV scheduling, SEC data services, predictive maintenance, and Power BI.

experience.progression: Computer Science Intern -> Industrial IoT & Data Engineering Intern -> current role
bullets: Build Python and SQL pipelines that combine IoT sensor streams, equipment alarm history, and M1 ERP records; standardize assets, measurements, missing values, and outlier handling for reliable reporting.
Develop predictive-maintenance workflows from vibration, temperature, humidity, and machine-state signals to surface abnormal behavior and support maintenance decisions.
Design Power BI dashboards for OEE, downtime, on-time delivery, vendor performance, production KPIs, and equipment health used by engineering and operations.
Integrate PLC-connected machinery with real-time monitoring and automate recurring operational reports.

projects.name: Raft + MVCC Database Lab
projects.bullet: Built five-node Raft consensus, serializable MVCC/OCC, and a linearizability checker; 598 assertions across seeded faults, 11-logical-tick failover, and minority leaders prevented from committing.

projects.bullet: Implemented paged KV caching, continuous batching, chunked prefill, and prefix caching; 90 tests, 94% vs. 21% KV utilization, 2.9x sequential throughput, and 5.5x better median TTFT in a CPU-scale benchmark.

projects.name: SEC EDGAR MCP Server
projects.bullet: Built filing search, identity resolution, bounded text windows, XBRL discovery, global request pacing, and host-aware caching; 32 offline tests and a measured 138x warm 10-K read improvement.

projects.name: Vectorized Columnar Engine
projects.bullet: Built null-aware vectorized filters, joins, aggregation, and TPC-H Q1; measured 53.1M rows/second with 6,288 assertions and 1.94x scalar-filter throughput.
